why: A (universes 0), for slice submanifolds N ⊆ V: Theorem 13.1 for every 2-parameter variation (IsVariation, U ⊆ ℝ² open, any break set) of an unbroken geodesic — the iterated LINE derivative ∂/∂u₁(∂E(α(u₁,u₂))/∂u₂|_{u₂=0}) at u₁ = 0 exists and equals 2·secondVariation γ W₁ W₂ — and its corollary second_variation_eq (well-definedness). B, for abstract connected ℝⁿ-manifolds with any Levi-Civita connection: for a 2-parameter blind variation of a geodesic, u ↦ fderiv(E∘α) u e₀ is FRÉCHET differentiable at 0 and ½·mixedD(E∘α) equals Milnor's formula with W₁ inside (jumps of DW₁/dt on the pieces, piece integrals, R via IsCurvVal). A ⇒ B and B ⇒ A fail genuinely, now ONLY because of the setting (abstract manifolds and every Levi-Civita connection vs slice submanifolds with the induced one): on embedded manifolds the two are equivalent (A ⇒ B_emb and B ⇒ A_emb proved, second attempt with RoundTrip/EnergyC2). Note (not a B bug): B differentiates in the other order and asserts more regularity than A; both harmless since E∘α is C^∞ (EnergyC2).
overlap: Main directions: none proved. A_emb := both conjuncts of A for connected slice submanifolds modelled on ℝⁿ (A_to_A_emb: A's special case). Proved A_to_B_emb (A's second_variation used as the hypothesis Emb.SV; #rt_check OK) and B_emb_to_A_emb, hence B_to_A_emb (B_emb gives the value; #rt_check OK). Dictionary built in the file (namespace Emb): blind 2-parameter IsVarSub ⇒ IsVariation (isVariation_of_isVarSub) and back (isVarSub_lift along a subdivision avoiding the break set); D_varField (blind fields = line derivatives along eᵢ); efun_eq + EnergyC2 (hess_data: B's DifferentiableAt clause and mixedD = iterated derivative; mixedD_eq = 2·secondVariation); sv_eq_rhs (blind right side — D1/D2 on closed pieces via Bridge.hasCovDeriv_iff', jumps D1 i(tᵢ) − D1(i−1)(tᵢ) = P(Δ W₁') via derivWithin_Ici/Iic_eq_of_piece, Σ over interior subdivision points = finsum over (0,1) via finsum_mem_Ioo_eq_sum, piece integrals = ∫₀¹ with integrability from continuousWithinAt_curvR, IsCurvVal ⇔ curvR via Bridge.isCurvVal_iff — equals the project's secondVariation); for B_emb ⇒ A: induced D1/D2 = Bridge.covA, Rv = L(curvR …) (tangent by curvOp_mem), geodesic congruence on [0,1], sv_congr_path, contDiffOn_varField, Fréchet ⇒ HasDerivAt of u₁ ↦ ∂F/∂u₂(u₁,0) from C². Limitations: only the induced connection (uniqueness of the Levi-Civita connection is not formalized), model ℝⁿ, connected ↥N.
